ad_library.summary: Ellvin Energy is running 6 live ads on Meta - all six sharing one Telugu creative (Library ID 1688280062277703, started 12 August 2026) - and every one of them sends the click into a Facebook lead form. The company was incorporated only in August 2025 (CIN U35105AP2025PTC120835), is headquartered in Tadepalli, Andhra Pradesh, and is advertising into Telangana in Telugu. No owned page receives any of this traffic.

funnel.meaning: Every lead is captured inside Facebook. There is no pixel on ellvinenergy.com, no retargeting pool, no landing page to test and no way to see what happens after the click.

findings: 6 live ads - and all 6 share one Telugu creative (Library ID 1688280062277703, running since 12 August 2026). One idea, six versions, no second angle and no retargeting creative.
Every click lands in a Facebook lead form - the paid traffic never reaches ellvinenergy.com. No pixel, no retargeting pool, no page you can test.
The company was incorporated only in August 2025 (CIN U35105AP2025PTC120835, directors Vijaya Bhaskar and Nirmala Gangavarapu) - a one-year-old installer buying Telugu solar leads in Telangana.
The creative promises a '3KW solar plant at zero cost' to 'the first 1 crore people' - eligibility language that needs a real landing page behind it, not just a form.
Headquartered in Tadepalli, Guntur (Andhra Pradesh), advertising into Telangana - no Hyderabad presence on the site, no local proof for a Telangana buyer.
next_steps: Build an owned Telugu landing page
Put the 'zero-cost 3KW' eligibility promise on a page you control - eligibility check, subsidy maths, quote form - and point all 6 ads at it.
Install the pixel and start retargeting
Six ads buying leads with no pixel on your site means no audience to re-market to. The Meta pixel plus a lead-form integration turns one click into a retargetable contact.
One creative cannot tell you which message works. Test a subsidy-focused and an EMI-focused Telugu version against each other.
Named local projects and a Telangana service area turn a cross-border advertiser into a local option for the homeowner reading the ad.

controls.name: Meta Pixel installed
controls.evidence: Landing page was not source-checked for this report; needs a page-source pull or account access.

controls.name: UTM parameters on ad destinations
controls.evidence: Live ads click to a Facebook lead form (fb.me) - traffic never reaches a page you own, so no URL can carry UTMs and click data stays inside Meta.

controls.name: Domain verification
controls.evidence: Business Manager domain verification cannot be observed from public ad data; needs account access.

controls.name: Creative format diversity
controls.evidence: Ad-card formats were not captured for these ads.

controls.name: Creative concept coverage
controls.evidence: Only 2 offer angle in live copy (government subsidy, discount offer) - every ad says the same thing.

controls.name: Social proof utilization
controls.evidence: No social proof (customer counts, reviews, testimonials) in the live ad copy.

controls.name: Video aspect ratios
controls.evidence: Creative files cannot be downloaded from the Ad Library; needs account access or the raw creatives.

controls.name: UGC / social-native content
controls.evidence: Content style cannot be verified from ad cards alone.

controls.name: CTR benchmark
controls.evidence: No spend or impression data is public for this advertiser; the catalog forbids benchmark guessing.

controls.name: Creative freshness
controls.evidence: Live creatives include recent launches (newest started Aug 12, 2026) - the account is not running one stale ad forever.

controls.name: Campaign fragmentation
controls.evidence: A single live ad - no internal comparison, no safety net if it fatigues.

controls.name: Campaign objective alignment
controls.evidence: Ad CTA and destination agree on one job: Facebook lead form only.

controls.name: Creative fatigue detection
controls.evidence: Frequency and performance decay need account metrics.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
